_comment: Bundled offline recipe pool — curated dishes for every region. Live APIs (TheMealDB / Spoonacular / Edamam) are tried first; these guarantee coverage for cuisines live sources cover thinly or not at all, including regions no free API touches. regions[] are matched in src/offline.js via resolveOfflineRegions. Offline = keyless, always available, no network; refresh by regenerating this file and committing.

recipes.name: Kokoda (Raw Fish in Coconut)
recipes.countryHint: Fiji, Samoa, Tonga, Cook Islands, Tuvalu
recipes.instructions: Dice the fish finely and marinate in lime juice until the flesh turns opaque. Add coconut milk, chilli, onion, tomato and coriander. Chill and serve cold.

recipes.name: Palusami (Taro Leaves in Coconut Cream)
recipes.instructions: Wilt taro leaves, stir in warm coconut cream and onion. Wrap portions into parcels and bake or steam until tender.

recipes.name: Ota Ika
recipes.instructions: Marinate cubed raw fish in citrus juice. Toss with coconut milk, cucumber, tomato, chilli and onion. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Kumala (Cassava) Cake
recipes.countryHint: Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands, Fiji
recipes.instructions: Mix grated cassava with coconut milk, sugar, butter and egg. Bake until set and golden. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Grilled Reef Fish with Lime
recipes.instructions: Score the fish, rub with garlic, ginger and lime, then grill over coals until charred and flaking. Finish with lime juice.

recipes.name: Lamb Barbecue ('Barbie')
recipes.instructions: Season lamb with oil, rosemary and garlic. Grill over high heat until charred outside and pink within. Rest before serving.

recipes.name: Pavlova
recipes.instructions: Whisk egg whites with sugar to stiff peaks, fold in cornflour and vinegar, and bake low until crisp outside, soft inside. Top with cream and fruit.

recipes.name: Anzac Biscuits
recipes.instructions: Melt butter with golden syrup and soda, mix into a dough with oats, flour and coconut. Bake in small rounds until golden and chewy.

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
recipes.instructions: Make a beer batter, coat fish fillets and deep-fry until crisp. Chip and fry the potatoes. Serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Jollof Rice
recipes.instructions: Blend tomatoes, pepper and onion to a smooth paste. Fry down, add stock and rice, cover and steam until smoky and separate.

recipes.name: Groundnut Peanut Stew (Mafé)
recipes.instructions: Braise meat with onion and tomato, add stock and peanut butter, then simmer with root vegetables until thick and rich.

recipes.name: Okra Stew
recipes.instructions: Slice okra and simmer with meat, stock and seasoning until silky and thick. Serve with fufu or rice.

recipes.name: Egusi Soup
recipes.instructions: Whisk egusi into palm oil and stock, add meat and season. Fold in greens and simmer until thick.

recipes.name: Thiéboudienne (Fish and Rice)
recipes.instructions: Stuff fish with aromatics, fry lightly, then build a tomato broth with vegetables. Poach the fish and cook rice in the broth.

recipes.name: Ugali and Sukuma Wiki
recipes.instructions: Make a stiff cornmeal porridge (ugali). Sauté collard greens with onion and tomato. Serve alongside.

recipes.name: Doro Wat (Spicy Chicken Stew)
recipes.instructions: Slowly caramelise onion, add berbere and spiced butter, then braise chicken. Add boiled eggs and simmer until deep red.

recipes.name: Nyama Choma (Grilled Meat)
recipes.instructions: Marinate meat in onion, ginger, garlic and lime; grill over coals until charred. Serve with kachumbari salad.

recipes.name: Matoke (Steamed Plantain)
recipes.instructions: Steam peeled plantain until soft. Make a light peanut and tomato sauce and serve over the mashed plantain.

recipes.name: Pap (Maize Porridge) and Chakalaka
recipes.instructions: Cook maize meal to a soft porridge (pap). Sauté vegetables with beans and chilli for chakalaka. Serve together.

recipes.name: Bunny Chow (Curry in Hollow Bread)
recipes.instructions: Hash the centre out of a half-loaf, fill with spicy meat-and-potato curry, and serve with the bread torn for dipping.

recipes.name: Sadza with Greens
recipes.instructions: Stir maize meal into boiling water to a smooth stiff dough (sadza). Cook greens with groundnut and tomato to serve over it.

recipes.name: Couscous with Seven Vegetables
recipes.instructions: Steam couscous over a fragrant vegetable and chickpea stew until fluffy. Serve the stew over the couscous.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.instructions: Reduce tomatoes and peppers with cumin and paprika to a thick base. Poach eggs in the sauce until set, and serve hot.

recipes.name: Brik (Crisp Fried Pastry)
recipes.instructions: Fill crisp pastry triangles with a tuna-egg mixture, fold and deep-fry until golden. Squeeze lemon over before eating.

recipes.name: Pepperpot (Guyana-Style)
recipes.instructions: Brown the meat, add cassareep, spices and water to cover, then simmer slowly for hours until dark and velvety.

recipes.name: Callaloo
recipes.instructions: Simmer greens and okra in coconut milk with seasoning, blend smooth, then finish with flaked fish or crab.

recipes.name: Rice and Peas
recipes.instructions: Simmer rice with beans, coconut milk and aromatics until tender and fragrant. Serve with jerk meats or stews.

recipes.name: Roti with Curry (Doubles)
recipes.instructions: Make a soft flatbread (roti), fill or top with curried chickpeas and chilli. Roll up and serve warm.

recipes.name: Empanadas
recipes.instructions: Fill pastry with seasoned beef, onion, olives and egg, fold into half-moons, seal and bake or fry until golden.

recipes.name: Ceviche
recipes.instructions: Marinate cubed fish in lime until barely cooked by the acid. Toss with onion, coriander and chilli. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Arepas
recipes.instructions: Mix cornmeal with salted water to a soft dough, shape into rounds and cook on a hot griddle until crisp outside, fluffy inside.

recipes.name: Feijoada (Black Bean Stew)
recipes.instructions: Simmer black beans with smoked pork, garlic, onion and bay until thick. Serve with rice and an orange slice.

recipes.name: Gallopinto (Rice and Beans)
recipes.instructions: Sauté rice with onion, garlic and pepper, add beans and stock, and cook until tender. Sprinkle with coriander.

recipes.name: Lomo Saltado
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry beef with soy, onion, tomato and chilli; add fried potatoes and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Bandeja Paisa
recipes.instructions: Plate rice, beans, seasoned beef, fried egg, plantain, a crispy arepa and avocado for a hearty platter.

recipes.name: Fajitas
recipes.instructions: Slice meat and vegetables, season and sear in a hot pan. Serve in warm tortillas with lime.

recipes.name: Macaroni and Cheese
recipes.instructions: Make a cheese sauce with butter, flour and milk, fold in cooked macaroni, top with crumbs and bake until golden.

recipes.name: Poutine
recipes.instructions: Pile hot fries, scatter cheese curds and pour over warm gravy so the cheese softens.

recipes.name: Tex-Mex Chili
recipes.instructions: Brown beef, add beans, tomato and spices, and simmer low until thick and fragrant.

recipes.name: Swedish Meatballs (Köttbullar)
recipes.instructions: Mix meat with soaked breadcrumbs, onion and spice; roll into balls and fry. Serve with a creamy sauce and lingonberry.

recipes.name: Fish Pie (Fiskegrateng)
recipes.instructions: Layer flaked fish and potato, cover with béchamel, breadcrumb and bake until bubbling and golden.

recipes.name: Herring in Cream
recipes.instructions: Fold chopped herring into sour cream with onion, apple and dill. Serve chilled as a starter.

recipes.name: Raggmunk (Potato Pancakes)
recipes.instructions: Grate potato into a light batter and fry spoonfuls until crisp and golden. Serve with lingonberries.

recipes.name: Herring and Rye (Nordic Board)
recipes.instructions: Assemble open sandwiches on rye with herring, egg, onion and dill for a classic smörgås.

recipes.name: Moules-Frites (Mussels and Fries)
recipes.instructions: Steam mussels in white wine with shallot, garlic and parsley until they open. Serve with crispy fries.

recipes.name: Sausage and Mash with Onion Gravy
recipes.instructions: Fry sausages, make buttery mashed potato and a rich onion gravy. Plate the trio together.

recipes.name: Cheese Fondue
recipes.instructions: Melt cheeses with wine, garlic and kirsch until silky. Dip cubes of crusty bread into the hot fondue.

recipes.name: Coq au Vin
recipes.instructions: Marinate chicken in red wine, then braise with bacon, mushrooms and herbs until tender and glossy.

recipes.name: Paella
recipes.instructions: Sizzle rice and saffron in a wide pan, add meat and seafood, pour stock and simmer until a crisp socarrat forms.

recipes.name: Risotto
recipes.instructions: Toast rice in butter and wine, add stock ladle by ladle while stirring until creamy. Finish with parmesan.

recipes.name: Moussaka
recipes.instructions: Layer fried aubergine and spiced lamb with tomato, top with béchamel and bake until golden.

recipes.name: Bacalhau à Brás
recipes.instructions: Shred rehydrated cod with matchstick potato and onion, scramble in egg, and finish with olives and parsley.

recipes.name: Pastitsio
recipes.instructions: Layer baked pasta with a spiced beef-tomato ragu, top with béchamel and cheese, and bake until golden.

recipes.name: Pierogi
recipes.instructions: Fill boiled-until-tender dumplings with potato-cheese or onion filling. Serve golden-fried with sour cream.

recipes.name: Borscht
recipes.instructions: Simmer beetroot, cabbage and potato in a rich beef stock. Serve hot with a swirl of sour cream and dill.

recipes.name: Goulash
recipes.instructions: Brown beef with onion and paprika, add vegetables and stock, and simmer until rich. Serve with dumplings.

recipes.name: Ćevapi (Grilled Sausages)
recipes.instructions: Season and shape minced meat into short sausages, grill until charred, and serve in flatbread with onion and ajvar.

recipes.name: Pelmeni (Dumplings)
recipes.instructions: Wrap seasoned minced meat in small pasta rounds, boil until they float and serve with butter and sour cream.

recipes.name: Wiener Schnitzel
recipes.instructions: Flatten the meat, bread it, and fry in plenty of butter or oil until golden and crisp. Serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Plov (Uzbek Rice and Meat)
recipes.instructions: Brown meat, layer rice over carrots and onion, add cumin and stock, and steam until the rice is fluffy and separate.

recipes.name: Beshbarmak (Noodles and Meat)
recipes.instructions: Boil meat in broth, cook wide noodles in the stock, then layer noodles with shredded meat and onions.

recipes.name: Manti (Steamed Dumplings)
recipes.instructions: Fill small dough squares with spiced lamb, seal, and steam. Serve with yogurt and melted butter.

recipes.name: Non (Oven Flatbread)
recipes.instructions: Knead a leavened dough, flatten into discs, mark the centre and bake until chewy and blistered.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger, add tomatoes and spices, then simmer chicken until tender and fragrant.

recipes.name: Lentil Dal
recipes.instructions: Simmer lentils with turmeric until soft, then temper garlic, cumin and tomato in ghee and stir through.

recipes.name: Biryani
recipes.instructions: Layer marinated meat and parboiled saffron rice, seal and steam until the aromas meld. Serve with raita.

recipes.name: Nepali Dal Bhat
recipes.instructions: Cook steamed rice and a spiced lentil dal; serve with sautéed vegetables and pickle.

recipes.name: Kottu Roti
recipes.instructions: Chop flatbread and stir-fry with vegetables, egg and curry sauce until charred and crisp-edged.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry noodles with egg, protein and beansprouts in a tangy tamarind sauce. Top with crushed peanuts.

recipes.name: Nasi Goreng
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry cold rice with aromatics, soy and chilli until smoky. Top with a fried egg.

recipes.name: Pho Bo (Beef Noodle Soup)
recipes.instructions: Simmer a fragrant stock with star anise and ginger, plunge in raw beef and noodles, finish with herbs and lime.

recipes.name: Green Curry
recipes.instructions: Fry green paste in coconut cream, add chicken and aubergine, simmer and finish with Thai basil.

recipes.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
recipes.instructions: Poach chicken, cook rice in the rich stock with ginger, and serve with sliced chicken and chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Laksa
recipes.instructions: Simmer a spicy coconut broth with shrimp paste and chilli, add noodles and seafood, and top with herbs.

recipes.name: Adobo
recipes.instructions: Braise meat in soy, vinegar, garlic and bay until tangy and glossy. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Amok Trei (Fish Curry)
recipes.instructions: Steam a coconut-fish custard with aromatic kroeung paste in banana-leaf cups until set.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry chicken with chilli and peanuts in a sweet-sour soy sauce, finishing with spring onion.

recipes.name: Bulgogi (Korean BBQ Beef)
recipes.instructions: Marinate thin beef in a soy-pear marinade, then grill or pan-fry until caramelised.

recipes.name: Ramen
recipes.instructions: Assemble cooked noodles in a rich seasoned broth and top with sliced pork, egg and spring onion.

recipes.name: Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi Stew)
recipes.instructions: Simmer aged kimchi with pork and stock, season with gochugaru, and cook until rich and fiery.

recipes.name: Claypot Rice
recipes.instructions: Cook rice with sausage, chicken and mushroom in a claypot until the base turns crisp. Glaze with soy.

recipes.name: Miso Soup
recipes.instructions: Stir miso into warm dashi, add cubed tofu and wakame, and finish with spring onion.

recipes.name: Kabsa (Spiced Rice and Chicken)
recipes.instructions: Braise chicken with tomato, onion and kabsa spice. Cook rice in the rich stock beneath the chicken.

recipes.name: Mansaf
recipes.instructions: Simmer lamb in a yogurt broth, layer over rice and flatbread, pour the broth over, and scatter pine nuts.

recipes.name: Khoresht Gheymeh
recipes.instructions: Brown meat, add split peas, tomato and dried lime, simmer until tender, then top with saffron and crispy potatoes.

recipes.name: Falafel and Hummus
recipes.instructions: Blend chickpeas with herbs, shape and fry. Serve crisp falafel with a smooth, garlicky hummus.

recipes.name: Kebab Koobideh
recipes.instructions: Knead seasoned mince well, skewer into long patties and grill. Serve with sumac and flatbread.

recipes.name: Shawarma
recipes.instructions: Marinate and roast meat, slice thin, and roll in flatbread with pickles and garlic sauce.
